		ai_will_do = { base = 1 }
	}

	COLDWAR_SVN_vie_integrate_south = {
		icon = generic_form_nation
		allowed = { NOT = { original_tag = SVN } }

		cost = 0
		fire_only_once = yes

		visible = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_vie_integration_consent }
		available = {
			tag = VIE
			has_war = no
			country_exists = SVN
			SVN = {
				is_subject_of = VIE
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_integration_consent_tt
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_integration_consent
				}
			}
		}

		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_SVN_vie_integrate_south"
			annex_country = { target = SVN transfer_troops = yes }
		}

		ai_will_do = { base = 10 }
	}

}
